summary: Full A-Z audit before Play Store submission. Backend: 12/12 pytest pass on iter38_premium — health, APK duplicate /api/api/profile/{id}, subscription/status returns is_premium+features+expires_at, google-play/verify (missing params → 400, invalid user → 404, valid → creates order + activates premium + 3-day trial for first-time + idempotent on duplicate token), subscription/cancel (marks cancelled, invalid user → 404), admin/premium-analytics (401 without token, 200 with admin token, returns summary keys total_premium/google_play/trialing/active_paid/cancelled/conversion_rate/estimated_revenue_inr/paid_orders + recent_orders array), verify-selfie-ai rejects missing input, and ai_chatbot.py has 'NEVER insult' + 'NEVER say anything sexually' + 'emotionally manipulate' rules in all 3 prompts (main line 646, stealth line 1301, custom line 1342).
